spec: specs/underwriting_spec.md — PolicyForge Sprint 2 (branch feat/application-underwriting, cut from dev). Scope: application submission with KYC stub and risk re-validation (AC-03.1–03.4); underwriting rules engine returning AUTO_BIND / MANUAL_REVIEW / DECLINE with reason codes from the active rule version (AC-04.1–04.6, including the parameterised reason-code matrix); underwriter workbench queue and decisions plus admin DECLINE override, with append-only decisions and actor-ID audit (AC-09.1–09.5, NFR-04); PII never logged (NFR-03.1); role boundary including CUSTOMER → underwriter endpoint 403 (NFR-04.1); React Apply page, application status page and Underwriter Workbench page with Vitest and Playwright (desktop + mobile) and a committed Playwright visual-snapshot directory. Build on the Sprint 1 code (catalog, quote engine, RiskInputSchema, RequestBodySizeLimitFilter, SecurityConfig). Constraints: root CLAUDE.md non-negotiables and folder CLAUDE.md files, especially the web/CLAUDE.md lessons KD-007 to KD-010 (consumes JSON on every state-changing endpoint, allow-list responses, explicit security matchers, fixed problem detail, default-deny limits on decoded paths); every test named AC-NN.M / NFR-NN.M; synthetic KYC data only; Flyway migrations append-only (next version after V3). TDD commit policy (user decision): each code task commits live on feat/application-underwriting — `test(red): AC-NN.M …` with the failing tests BEFORE the implementation, then `feat(green): …`, then `refactor: …` when there is cleanup; stage explicit paths and commit with `git commit -m "…" -- <paths>`; never push; never commit on dev or main; also save red/green test output to sprint-progress/<TASK>-red.log and <TASK>-green.log in the workspace. Environment: java is not on PATH — prefix Maven with `export JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21.0.12.101-hotspot"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"`; integration tests run under failsafe (selective syntax in .claude/agents/security-reviewer.md); leave port 8080 free. Use project agents and skills where they fit (test-engineer and spec-to-test-generator for red, ui-designer for pages; evaluator uses Playwright MCP).
